description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearCache, which implements the clearCache method for the Smarty templating system. It provides functionality to clear cached templates, interacting with the Smarty cache resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearCache
classes.description: A class that provides the method to clear cached templates within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the cache for a specific template, optionally using cache and compile IDs and expiration time.
